You're most like
—

Raised underfoot, not in a cage.

Born June 30, 2026 in our spare room, these four have never known anything but hands, laps, and each other.

No kennels, no rescue backstory — just a mama cat, a quiet corner of the house, and four kittens who've spent eight weeks getting picked up, talked to, and fussed over by everyone who walks through the door.

  • Litter-box trained since week 5
  • Comfortable being held, brushed, and handled
  • First deworming done, vet check-up scheduled
